name: lazy-browser-fixture
goal: Shared browser monitoring preserves API-only checks without a browser executable

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: The first implementation made an automatic fixture depend on context, adding a browser prerequisite to request-only tests.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test that faithfully reproduces the defect; record proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged API-only test with /nonexistent/harness-browser failed because the automatic guard attempted Chromium launch.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Move context monitoring into the lazy context fixture and require an unavailable-browser API boundary check whenever shared fixture dependencies change.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: The automatic collector now depends only on the browser-name option. The context fixture attaches monitoring when requested; root/generated guidance enforces the boundary review.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: All 22 focused regressions passed, including real browser errors and API-only operation without a browser executable.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: The built CLI generated an isolated app. Its API-only test passed, failed when the original eager context dependency was restored only in that fixture, then passed again after restoration: 0 / 1 / 0.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
steps.evidence: Focused browser error, bucket activity, and lazy fixture proofs pass. Full verification remains pending: reports-concurrent-runs.e2e.test.ts times out at its unchanged 180-second history-seeding assertion on both this implementation and isolated baseline ff47c377, before browser results.
